result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: restaurant names truncated in the Fastest near you carousel and an incomplete pizza card missing its title and details.

issues.description: Restaurant names under Fastest near you are truncated: 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word, and possibly others lack full visibility.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure card width accommodates full restaurant names without clipping.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card shows only the image with a -20% badge and heart icon; restaurant name, rating, delivery time, and other details present on the ramen card above are missing.
issues.suggestion: Add the restaurant name, metadata (time, delivery fee, cuisine), and rating below the pizza image consistent with other popular items.
